description_en: Quick and accurate character detection in images from online scenarios such as E-commerce product promotional images, community forum images, and user-generated content (UGC) images
description_zh: 针对电商商品宣传图片、社区贴吧图片、网络UGC图片等网络场景下图片字符快速精准识别
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-basic --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/sdqwab/%E7%94%B5%E5%95%86%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --need-rotate false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeBasic

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one of them.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one of them.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. Default value: true.  
true: Enable rotation.  
false: Disable rotation.
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要自动旋转功能，默认需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: need_rotate

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if OCR succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Data.example: {     "content":"官科沃斯机器人丨聚划算",     "height":415,     "orgHeight":415,     "orgWidth":417,     "prism_version":"1.0.9",     "prism_wnum":8,     "prism_wordsInfo":[         {             "angle":-89,             "direction":0,             "height":249,             "pos":[                 {                     "x":17,                     "y":17                 },                 {                     "x":266,                     "y":17                 },                 {                     "x":266,                     "y":39                 },                 {                     "x":17,                     "y":39                 }             ],             "prob":95,             "width":21,             "word":"官科沃斯机器人丨聚划算",             "x":131,             "y":-96         }     ],     "width":417 }

Message.description_en: Error message (this field is not returned if OCR succeeded)
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
